latest.title: Every site has its own page, and you can search the board
latest.summary: Each shop, warehouse, factory and office now opens as its own page with an address, so a reload keeps it and Back and Forward walk between sites; a crumb takes you back to where you came from, and site names on Today, Supply and the map link to it. Press / or Ctrl+K to search the whole board: pages, your sites, products, kinds of finding, location presets and the game's help pages, with everyday words like hire, debt or difficulty. Today has an Ask the board row whose questions land on the answer. The difficulty you play on sits beside the clock, and Company › Results can show your week by weekday.
